# Absence report intake (SharePoint "Student Absence Log" -> Attendance 0s)

Approved 2026-10-06 (build 8). Parent reports become absences automatically; the office only classifies them
(Absences > Classify absences) or fixes reports that could not be matched (Absences > Mapping Errors).

## Flows (solution-aware, in AACA Attendance; generated by `build_absence_intake_flows.py`)

| Flow | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| AACA - Absence Report Intake | child flow, input = SharePoint item ID | processes one report (below) and responds status/created/conflicts/error |
| AACA - Absence Report Intake (SharePoint) | item created or modified in the Absence Log | runs the child for that item |
| AACA - Absence Report Backfill | manual, run once per environment | runs the child for every report (already-decided ones are skipped) |

Deploy / update: `flows/Deploy-AbsenceIntakeFlows.ps1 -EnvironmentUrl <dev> [-Activate]` (Dev; Test/Prod get the flows
through the solution). Test one report in Dev: `flows/Test-AbsenceIntake.ps1 ... -ReportId <id>` (temporary harness flow,
because the Flow API cannot pass inputs to a manual trigger).

## Rules (child flow)

1. Skip if a Report Decisions row exists for the item and is not an Error (approved/dismissed earlier, or processed).
2. No Student_ID -> nothing written (shows in Mapping Errors "No Student ID": Match_Status = "Needs Review").
3. Student ID not in the app / unreadable dates (M/D/YYYY) / more than 60 days -> Report Decisions row, Processing
   Status = Error, owned by the School Site's campus (Mapping Errors "Could not process"). Fixing the SharePoint item
   (Map / Fix dates) re-triggers processing.
4. Reports whose absence date is before 2026-01-01 are ignored.
5. Days = Absence Date up to (not including) Return Date (blank/invalid return = one day), school days only per the
   enrollment's campus (inside a term, weekday or make-up day, no closing calendar exception), enrolled days only,
   future dates included.
6. Per day: no row -> create Attendance 0 (Source = Parent report, Notice Received On = SharePoint Created, Source Report
   ID, Notes = "Parent report #id: reason", enrollment/teacher/campus/term/ratio, owner = campus team); undone row ->
   revived as the 0; teacher's present row -> flagged Parent Reported Absent (Needs a decision), never overwritten;
   already absent -> skipped.
7. Report Decisions row: Processed + days created / skipped / conflict, owned by the campus team.

Campus team ids come from Campus.Owner Team ID (set by Deploy-Security.ps1). The flow never writes to SharePoint.
